title: Global sections of affine pushforward are restriction of scalars
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, and let $\psi=\operatorname{Spec}\varphi$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. In the categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], there is a natural isomorphism from $F\mapsto\Gamma_R(\psi_*F)$ to $\Gamma_S$ followed by restriction of scalars along $\varphi$. On underlying elements of global sections this isomorphism and its inverse are the identity; the $R$-action on $\Gamma_R(\psi_* F)$ agrees with restriction of the $S$-action on $\Gamma_S(F)$.

proof.text: On global sections both underlying abelian groups are Γ(Spec S,F), since the preimage of the whole space is the whole space. For r in R, the action in the pushforward is multiplication by (Spec.map φ).appTop ((ΓSpecIso R).inv r). Naturality ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality identifies this element with (ΓSpecIso S).inv (φ r), exactly the restricted action. Thus identity on elements gives a linear equivalence. All sheaf morphisms have the same underlying maps on global sections, so these equivalences are natural. This is the complete already compiled construction of pushforwardSpecMapCompΓIso.
